content: Cloud Run cold starts: Node ~100-400ms plus app init; mitigate with --min-instances=1 and startup CPU boost (Node startup up to ~30% faster); keep image small, lazy-load heavy deps, avoid sync init work. Min instances cost money continuously but eliminate 0->1 cold start which matters for chat/WebSocket first connection. Sources: cloud.google.com general tips, startup CPU boost announcement, oneuptime min-instances guide.
